RemediationStrings.Title: Your system drive is almost full.
RemediationStrings.Description: Free up at least 10% of your system drive: empty the Recycle Bin and move large files to OneDrive.

RemediationStrings.Title: Your device firmware is out of date.
RemediationStrings.Description: Install the latest firmware update from your device manufacturer, or contact the IT helpdesk.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint isn't running.
RemediationStrings.Description: Restart your device. If this message remains, contact the IT helpdesk.
